summary: Star Equity Holdings filed a routine 8-K on August 21, 2026, announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on its 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (STRRP). The record date is September 1, 2026, and the payment date is September 10, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. This is an ordinary dividend declaration and does not constitute a special situation. Watch for consistent preferred dividend coverage, but no deal terms are stated.
